title: Lens Replacement Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lens:replacement
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by replacement_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when lens replacement log data has stopped arriving for a given replacement type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per replacement type and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your lens replacement log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
